title: Enable continuous TRIM via fstab
summary: Add the discard option to /etc/fstab to enable continuous TRIM for a specific filesystem. Note that this may cause freezes on older SATA drives.

steps.explain: Edit /etc/fstab and add 'discard' to the mount options for the SSD partition. For example, change 'defaults' to 'defaults,discard'. Do not use this on XFS root partitions; use kernel parameters instead.

rollback.explain: Remove the 'discard' option from /etc/fstab and remount the filesystem or reboot.

warnings: Continuous TRIM can cause system freezes on SATA drives older than SATA 3.1.
Data loss can occur if the SSD does not properly support TRIM.
